newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY JUMPS VS BASKET AS FOREIGNERS BUY.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY JUMPS VS BASKET AS FOREIGNERS BUY.

text.p: The zloty closed at 3.25/3.20 pct from the trading band centre, stronger than Tuesday's 3.17/3.13 pct as foreign investors bought Polish T-bills, dealers said.
* The central bank did not stage any currency-buying interventions, likely because it did not want to knock down the zloty before Thursday's 500 million zloty T-bill auction.
* It closed at 3.1080/00 to the dollar, down from 3.1070/80 on Tuesday and at 1.8085/00 to the mark, up from 1.8120/30.
* O/N at 22.70/23.30 pct, down from opening's 23.20/23.40.
* T/N dip to 22.80/23.30 pct from Tuesday's 23.10/23.30.
